messages:
Nina H.: Quick live-thread from today's all-hands reliability segment. Capturing owners, dates, and who needs what. RCA here: https://docs.redwood.com/rcas/INC-3841. Keep replies short so I can compile the weekly rollup. :memo:

Carlos M.: Can we lock the fallback routing canary date? Product asked for a concrete day they can block off.

Tess R.: +1 from support. Also need the exact telemetry tags we'll watch so runbooks align.

Nina H.: Propose 2026-04-12 start in prod-canary. Monitoring block 72h. Initial traffic: 0.5% -> 3% -> 15% if green. Calendar invite after confirmation.

Carlos M.: Works for product. Please publish the success/rollback criteria in the canary PR.

Tess R.: Simple rollback signals suggestion: sustained 5xx > 0.45% for 5m OR p95 latency +30% over baseline for 10m. Also pause if we get 2 P1 customer reports in any 30m window.

Nina H.: Noted. I'll add those to the checklist. Also tagging test owners now.

Carlos M.: Ops snippet for implementers:
```
kubectl apply -f configs/fallback/2026-04-12-canary.yaml --context=prod-canary
# ramp: 30s burst window, pause 10m between steps
```
Keep burst window at 30s while validating.

Deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: fallback-2026-04-12 in prod-canary at 2026-03-29T11:30:00Z (build 1254).

Tess R.: I'll add tracing tag examples to the runbook (service:fallback, route:chat, incident:INC-3841) so partners know what to search.

Amy L.: Quick finance note: tracing retention bump estimate came back ~4.6k/mo. If under $5k I can approve via liaison; I'll mark it approved once register updated.

Nina H.: Who will maintain the action register and publish the Friday snapshot for execs? We need one owner.

Carlos M.: I'll own the register for this incident. Will publish weekly status Friday EOD. Owners: canary -> @Nina H., tracing retention -> @Tess R., partner comms -> @Amy L.

Tess R.: Runbook link: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/fallback-2026-04. I'll post specific test cases and telemetry queries by EOD.

Amy L.: Can product please supply a short customer-facing note template? We'll need it ready in case we pause the rollout.

Carlos M.: I'll draft a template and drop in the runbook.

Nina H.: Perfect. I'll fold all of this into the master action register and share the consolidated list. Ping me if blocked. :white_check_mark:
